lines.say: A microwave heats food with no flame at all. Here's how.
lines.caption: No flame

lines.say: Inside is a magnetron. It fires invisible microwaves into the box.
lines.caption: Magnetron

lines.say: The metal walls bounce them around, and the mesh in the door keeps them in.
lines.caption: Walls

lines.say: Water molecules in your food twist back and forth, billions of times a second.
lines.caption: Water

lines.say: All that jiggling rubs together, and that friction is heat.
lines.caption: Heat

lines.say: The waves leave hot and cold spots, so the plate spins.
lines.caption: Spin
